description: Watch a web page and alert the user when it changes: price drops, restocks, new posts or listings, status changes, competitor updates, any 'tell me when this page changes'. Creates a website monitor that keeps watching after this conversation ends: monity.ai checks the page on a schedule in its own cloud browser, keeps a full-page screenshot and a full HTML copy of the page for every check, and alerts only when the change matters (an AI summary says what changed). Subject to the account plan's monitor limit. compareType AUTO (default) covers most pages; VISUAL for pixel comparison, TEXT for keyword monitoring, HTML for markup diffs. To watch one element pass selector (a CSS selector). Express the full intent in one call: use notifyWhen for a natural-language alert condition ('price drops below $500'), or notifyConditions + outputExtractor/jsonPath for deterministic threshold alerts without AI.

actions.description: Ordered list of interactions to perform before each check, e.g. [{"type":"CLICK","selector":"#accept-cookies"},{"type":"WAIT","value":1500},{"type":"CLICK","selector":".load-more"}]. Use this when the content to watch is behind a cookie banner, a tab, a "show more" control, or a dropdown. Max 20 steps. Script and JS/CSS injection steps are dashboard-only and rejected here.

active.description: Defaults to true; false keeps the step but skips it

selector.description: How to find the element, as a Playwright selector. CSS by default ("#accept-cookies", ".product .price"); a string starting with "/" is treated as XPath ("//button[contains(text(),'Show more')]"); Playwright engine prefixes also work, and "text=Show more" is usually the most robust choice for a button identified by its label rather than by a hashed class. Required for CLICK, TYPE, SELECT, MOUSEOVER and BLOCK.

type.description: CLICK a element, TYPE text into it, SELECT a dropdown option, MOUSEOVER to reveal a menu, SCROLL (optionally by pixels), WAIT a number of milliseconds, REFRESH the page, or BLOCK (remove) an element from the page before comparing

value.description: Text to type for TYPE, option to pick for SELECT, milliseconds for WAIT (max 60000), pixels for SCROLL

frequency.description: Minutes between checks, as a string: '5', '15', '30', '60' (hourly), '180', '360', '720', '1440' (daily), '10080' (weekly), '302400' (monthly). Omit for the plan default. A frequency faster than the plan allows is raised to the plan minimum.

jsonPath.description: For JSON API endpoints: JSONPath to the value to monitor, e.g. $.data.items[0].price. Starts with '$'.

keywords.description: TEXT monitors only: comma-separated keywords to watch for, e.g. "sold out, unavailable"

keywordsAction.description: TEXT monitors only: alert when keywords are ADDED to the page (default) or REMOVED from it

labels.description: Label names to file the monitor under (up to 10); existing labels with the same name are reused.

name.description: Monitor name (defaults to the URL host/path)

notifyConditions.description: Deterministic alert conditions on the extracted output (no AI credits). All conditions must pass. Requires the output to change. Mutually exclusive with notifyWhen. Not available for HTML monitors.

conditionType.description: con = output contains value, eq = equals, not = does not equal, gt/gte/lt/lte = numeric comparison of the extracted output

notifyWhen.description: Natural-language alert condition evaluated by AI on every check, e.g. 'notify me when the price drops below $500' or 'alert when the Pro plan changes'. Mutually exclusive with notifyConditions.

outputExtractor.description: How to extract the monitored value from the page text: NUMBER pulls the first number (good for prices), REGEX applies outputExtractorPattern, NONE keeps the full text.

outputExtractorPattern.description: Regular expression for outputExtractor: REGEX — bare pattern or /pattern/flags; the first capture group (or full match) becomes the monitored output, e.g. 'In stock: (\d+)'

selector.description: CSS selector of ONE element to watch instead of the whole page (e.g. '.product-price' or '#stock-status'). Makes an element monitor that is found by this selector on every check; leave compareType unset.

websiteUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to monitor

workspaceId.description: Workspace to create the monitor in (from list_workspaces): one of the workspaces this connection may use. Defaults to the person’s personal workspace when they allowed it.

name: create_monitor
title: Create monitor
